name: Filesystem
description: 读取本地文件，预览并应用文件创建、文本替换及按行复制或剪切。
author: Modera
agentGuidance: Read relevant files before editing. Prefer filesystem_copy when the desired text already exists on disk; its line coordinates refer to the files before the operation. Inspect every changed file in the approval preview. Use absolute paths outside the project; relative paths resolve from the current project, ~ expands to the user home directory. Carry returned versions on read continuation, reread after formatting, and avoid unrelated changes.

tools.description: Read local text/directories, images (PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP), PDF, Word (DOCX/DOC), spreadsheets (XLSX/XLS/XLSB/XLSM/ODS/CSV), and presentations (PPTX/PPT). Images return bounded visual data; GIF returns first frame. Documents extract plain text, not layout or OCR; legacy DOC/PPT recovery is incomplete. Use startLine/maxLines for text and documents; directory offset for listing; large plain text uses byte cursor/nextCursor. Carry version on continuation to reject changed files. Media <=32 MiB; text output bounded. Optional endLine selects an inclusive range; reversed ranges are swapped. Directories are sorted and versioned, with offset paging (maximum 50000 entries). Paths support ~ and absolute/project-relative paths.

zh-CN.description: 读取文本、目录、图片及 PDF/Office 文档；支持分页和按行读取，文档提取正文，图片返回视觉数据。

endLine.description: Inclusive end line. Reversed ranges are swapped. Responses remain bounded to 200 lines and the output budget; follow nextLine/nextCursor with version.

tools.title: 读取文件或目录

tools.description: Create a local text file, creating parent directories only when applied. Existing files require overwrite=true and retain encoding/BOM. Optional autoFormat runs before the actual output is previewed. The host obtains approval in this call; changed files are rejected. Maximum 2 MiB. Paths support ~ and absolute/project-relative paths.

tools.title: 创建文件

tools.description: Replace local text preserving encoding/BOM and untouched newlines. LF/CRLF matching and copied line-number prefixes are supported. Multiple matches require occurrence (1-based). Optional fuzzyMatching enables whitespace recovery, uniform space-indentation repair for Python/YAML/Makefile, and bounded fuzzy matching (similarity >0.85 without discarding indentation). Ambiguity is rejected. Optional formatting runs before approval. The host previews the actual output and approves within this call; stale files and no-op edits are rejected.

tools.title: 替换文件文本
复制或剪切文件行
tools.description: Copy/cut an inclusive source line range to a target without retyping its content. mode=insert (default) inserts before targetLine, position=after inserts after it, and omitted targetLine appends. mode=replace requires targetLine and targetEndLine. deleteSource=true cuts the source range. Coordinates refer to files BEFORE this operation. Reversed ranges are swapped and end lines clamped. Same-file overlapping cuts and no-op operations are rejected. New targets inherit source encoding/BOM; existing targets keep encoding/BOM, untouched newlines and trailing-newline state. Pasted lines adopt target newlines. The host previews ALL changed files and obtains approval in this call. Both source and target are checked for conflicts. Cross-file cuts stage both outputs and attempt rollback on failure; they are not a filesystem-wide atomic transaction. Files and outputs must be at most 2 MiB. Optional formatting is completed before preview; reread after formatted operations. Paths support ~ and absolute/project-relative paths.
